panels.title: Ladekosten
panels.description: Gesamte erfasste Kosten aller Ladevorgänge im Zeitraum. Ladevorgänge ohne Kosten zählen als null; lege in TeslaMate Preise für Geofences fest.

targets.rawSql:
WITH periods AS (
        SELECT n, t0, t1 FROM (VALUES
          (1, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - (($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') - ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')), ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC')),
          (2, ($__timeFrom()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'), ($__timeTo()::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'))) v(n, t0, t1)),
chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT p.t1 AS time, m.* FROM periods p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT SUM(cost) AS "cost__$currency" FROM chg WHERE start_date >= p.t0 AND start_date < p.t1) m ORDER BY p.n

panels.title: Durchschnittspreis pro kWh

panels.title: Ladeeffizienz
panels.description: In der Batterie angekommene Energie / von der Ladestation bezogene Energie, nach Energie gewichtet, für den gewählten Zeitraum. Der Rest geht als Wärme in Ladegerät und Kabeln sowie für die Batteriekonditionierung verloren. Die Linie in der Anzeige zeigt den laufenden Wert über den Zeitraum.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT start_date AS time,
       SUM(added) OVER w * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used) OVER w, 0) AS efficiency
FROM chg WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY start_date) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Monatliche Ladekosten nach Ladeart
panels.description: Erfasste Ladekosten pro Monat, eine Linie pro Ladeart. Drei Ladearten: Zuhause (die unter 'Zuhause laden bei' gewählten Geofences), Öffentlich AC und DC-Schnellladen.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (

               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,

               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT ((date_trunc('month', ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AS time,
COALESCE(SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Home'), 0) AS "home__$currency",
COALESCE(SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Public AC'), 0) AS "ac__$currency",
COALESCE(SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'DC'), 0) AS "dc__$currency"
FROM chg WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Wo zahle ich am meisten, und welcher DC-Lader ist am schnellsten?
Kosten nach Ort (Top 10)
panels.description: Die zehn Orte, an denen im Zeitraum am meisten Geld ausgegeben wurde. Jede Beschriftung zeigt außerdem den Durchschnittspreis pro kWh und die dort geladene Energie.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,

               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT place || '  ·  ' || COALESCE(ROUND((SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(used), 0))::numeric, 2)::text, '?')
         || '/kWh  ·  ' || ROUND(SUM(used)::numeric) || ' kWh' AS place,
       SUM(cost) AS "cost__$currency"
FROM chg WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) AND cost > 0
GROUP BY chg.place ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: DC-Lader nach realer Geschwindigkeit (Top 10)
panels.description: Durchschnittliche Ladeleistung zwischen 10% und 80% Ladestand an jedem DC-Standort, gemittelt über die Ladevorgänge. Das ist die tatsächlich erreichte Geschwindigkeit, nicht die Nennleistung der Ladesäule. Es werden nur Orte mit 2 oder mehr Ladevorgängen angezeigt.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
s AS (SELECT chg.id, chg.place, AVG(c.charger_power) AS kw
      FROM chg JOIN charges c ON c.charging_process_id = chg.id
      WHERE chg.kind = 'DC' AND $__timeFilter(chg.start_date)
        AND c.charger_power > 0 AND c.battery_level BETWEEN 10 AND 80
      GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT place || '  ·  ' || COUNT(*) || ' Ladevorgänge' AS place, AVG(kw) AS power
FROM s GROUP BY s.place HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Wie viel Energie geht verloren, und wann?
Ladeeffizienz nach Außentemperatur
panels.description: Anteil der bezogenen Energie, der in der Batterie angekommen ist, nach Außentemperatur (in deiner TeslaMate-Einheit, fünf Bereiche, jeweils an ihrem Mittelpunkt eingetragen) und Ladeart. Kälte senkt ihn, weil die Batterie beim Laden beheizt wird. Drei Ladearten: Zuhause (die unter 'Zuhause laden bei' gewählten Geofences), Öffentlich AC und DC-Schnellladen.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
tband AS (
        SELECT b, lo, hi,
               CASE WHEN lo IS NULL THEN '< ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    WHEN hi IS NULL THEN '> ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
                    ELSE ROUND(convert_celsius((lo)::numeric, '$temp_unit')) || ' – ' || ROUND(convert_celsius((hi)::numeric, '$temp_unit'))
               END || ' °$temp_unit' AS label
        FROM (VALUES (0, NULL::numeric, 0::numeric), (1, 0, 10), (2, 10, 20),
                     (3, 20, 30), (4, 30, NULL)) v(b, lo, hi))
SELECT convert_celsius((COALESCE((tband.lo + tband.hi) / 2, tband.lo + 5, tband.hi - 5))::numeric, '$temp_unit') AS temperature,
(SUM(added) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Home') * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Home'), 0)) AS "home",
(SUM(added) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Public AC') * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'Public AC'), 0)) AS "ac",
(SUM(added) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'DC') * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used) FILTER (WHERE kind = 'DC'), 0)) AS "dc"
FROM tband LEFT JOIN chg ON (tband.lo IS NULL OR chg.temp >= tband.lo) AND (tband.hi IS NULL OR chg.temp < tband.hi)
  AND $__timeFilter(chg.start_date)
GROUP BY tband.b, tband.lo, tband.hi ORDER BY tband.b

panels.title: Wohin das Ladegeld geflossen ist
panels.description: Die Ladekosten des Zeitraums, dreifach aufgeteilt. Beim Laden verloren: der Anteil der Kosten jedes Ladevorgangs, der für Energie bezahlt wurde, die nie in der Batterie angekommen ist. Im Stand verloren: im Stand verlorene Energie x dein Durchschnittspreis pro kWh. Fahren: der Rest.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
price AS (
        SELECT SUM(cost) / NULLIF(SUM(used), 0) AS p FROM chg WHERE cost > 0),
t AS (SELECT
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) FROM chg
     WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)) AS total,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost * (used - added) / NULLIF(used, 0)), 0) FROM chg
     WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date)) AS charging,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(loss_kwh), 0) * (SELECT p FROM price) FROM park
     WHERE $__timeFilter(t0)) AS parked)
SELECT v.part, v.amount AS "amount__$currency" FROM t CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES
  ('Fahren', GREATEST(t.total - t.charging - COALESCE(t.parked, 0), 0)),
  ('Beim Laden verloren', t.charging),
  ('Im Stand verloren', t.parked)) v(part, amount)
WHERE t.total > 0

panels.title: Wie fällt die DC-Leistung, wenn sich die Batterie füllt?
DC-Ladekurve
panels.description: Median der Ladeleistung bei jedem Ladestand (5%-Schritte) über alle DC-Ladevorgänge im Zeitraum, Tesla Supercharger im Vergleich zu anderen Netzen. Jeder Ladevorgang zählt einmal pro Schritt, und ein Schritt benötigt 2 Ladevorgänge. Eine flache, hohe Kurve bedeutet kurze Stopps.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Unbekannt') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
s AS (SELECT chg.id, FLOOR(c.battery_level / 5.0) * 5 AS soc,
             COALESCE(bool_or(c.fast_charger_brand = 'Tesla'), false) AS tesla,
             AVG(c.charger_power) AS kw
      FROM chg JOIN charges c ON c.charging_process_id = chg.id
      WHERE chg.kind = 'DC' AND $__timeFilter(chg.start_date)
        AND c.charger_power > 0 AND c.battery_level IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY 1, 2)
SELECT soc,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tesla) >= 2 THEN
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kw) FILTER (WHERE tesla)
       END AS tesla,
       CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT tesla) >= 2 THEN
         percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY kw) FILTER (WHERE NOT tesla)
       END AS other
FROM s GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ladevorgänge nach Wochentag und Stunde
panels.description: Anzahl der Ladevorgänge, die in jeder Stunde jedes Wochentags begonnen wurden, in der Zeitzone des Dashboards. Dunkler bedeutet häufiger.

targets.rawSql:
WITH data AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int AS hr,
         EXTRACT(DOW FROM ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int AS dow
  FROM charging_processes
  WHERE car_id = $car_id AND $__timeFilter(start_date)
    AND charge_energy_added > 0)
SELECT h.hr::text AS "Hour",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 1) AS "Mo",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 2) AS "Di",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 3) AS "Mi",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 4) AS "Do",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 5) AS "Fr",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 6) AS "Sa",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.dow = 0) AS "So"
FROM generate_series(0, 23) AS h(hr) LEFT JOIN data d ON d.hr = h.hr
GROUP BY h.hr ORDER BY h.hr
